# Henry Luan

> Enterprise AI infrastructure and agentic AI architecture consultant.

This is the personal professional site for Henry Luan. The domain is bigkpi.com; the professional brand should be understood as Henry Luan.

Henry Luan helps organizations translate AI business needs into software architecture, hardware decisions, compute clusters, and production AI systems. His work focuses on enterprise AI infrastructure, GPU procurement, CUDA/ROCm compatibility, private LLM deployment, agentic AI platforms, multimodal AI systems, RAG, government AI systems, and inference optimization.

## Core Expertise

- Enterprise AI infrastructure assessment
- GPU procurement review and workload sizing
- CUDA, ROCm, driver, framework, and model-serving compatibility
- Compute cluster setup for multi-machine AI deployments
- Private LLM deployment and local AI systems
- Enterprise agentic AI architecture
- Multimodal AI systems including speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and immersive interfaces
- Production inference optimization, batching, concurrency, latency, and hardware utilization
- Enterprise RAG, semantic search, hybrid search, and knowledge systems
- Government and enterprise AI delivery, including procurement cycles, budget cycles, pricing expectations, timelines, and bidding processes
